research_question: With the current utterance held exactly constant, does valid verified interaction history produce a traceable change in the selected desired-response branch and an observable next-turn prediction that can later be supported, contradicted, or left unknown?
controlled_variables: exact current utterance within each pair

execution_contract.case_isolation: fresh isolated runtime and temporary adaptive store per case
execution_contract.sequence: seed explicit response-form request -> decisive support -> fixed ambiguous current utterance -> feedback verification turn
execution_contract.pair_intervention: only seed desired-response condition changes within a pair; current utterance remains byte-identical
execution_contract.no_answer_leakage: reserve labels are read only by the evaluator and are not available to runtime inference
execution_contract.raw_memory_boundary: no raw dialogue, raw model response, or unverified mental-state claim may enter factual long-term memory or the adaptive persisted ledger

required_branch_contract.literal_observation: current-turn visible signal ids and M33 source-atom availability are recorded separately from pragmatic hypotheses
required_branch_contract.candidate_branches: at least selected and runner-up communicative-goal/desired-response branches with operational utility or probability
required_branch_contract.evidence: current explicit, verified reversible context, relationship, and unavailable acoustic evidence remain typed and distinguishable
required_branch_contract.selection: selected policy/mode, authority basis, uncertainty, and bounded alternative are explicit
required_branch_contract.prediction: next-turn prediction refers only to observable feedback behavior, never to private mental-state truth
required_branch_contract.verification: the next actual turn records supported, contradicted, uncertain, or not-available against the previous branch id
required_branch_contract.revision: contradiction may select a new explicit response policy but may not rewrite the original branch evidence

claim_boundary: controlled context-sensitivity and correction mechanism, not ground-truth access to private intent, not human felt-understanding preference evidence, not same-model superiority, and not a general human-brain equation
post_result_rule: do_not_modify_m34_from_m34_reserve_outcomes; failures move to a new milestone and a new reserve
